authority: #K2-452 sec.2.4 item 3 (fix + regression, or a read-only proof that it does not affect C1).
symptom: R1420 (and R1392/R1402, identical 244 every time): 241 x GND + 3 x MCU_VDD edges blocked with 'exception:KeyError' - opaque, because the maze caught the exception and recorded only the type name.
diagnostic: ONE bounded, read-only diagnostic (single net, distinct work dir, no board landed, K2MR_EXC_TRACE=1) - not a rerun of the graded configuration: the traceback names the site.

root_cause.site: tools/k2_p4_mroute_v1.py:513 in snap_node -> grid.bad[layer], reached from the WRAPPER's port-goal retry (tools/k2_reroute_router_floor_v1.py:304) because __ports()__ returned the J13 port pad's layer as the STRING 'F.Cu' (assigned in the _PP block from GetLayerName), while grid.bad is keyed by pcbnew layer IDs.
root_cause.blast_radius: every net that owns a J13 pad - i.e. GND (241) and MCU_VDD (3) - so the #K2-431 'port-aware goals' lever was DEAD for exactly those two nets.

fix: tools/k2_reroute_router_floor_v1.py: _norm_layer(layer, lname2id) normalises a NAME to the pcbnew ID (IDs pass through) and _ports() applies it to the mr._PORT_PADS entries; plus the maze now records exceptions WITH their name and message (never 'exception:KeyError' again) and the endpoint lookup names an absent uuid instead of raising.

red_green_evidence_same_command.command: wrapper --only-net MCU_VDD (same board/drc/frame/priority as the chain)

honest_caveat: the above proves the exception is GONE and replaced by a NAMED reason, and it shows the 3 MCU_VDD edges were blocked before and after (=> C1-neutral for those 3). For the 241 GND edges the retry now actually runs, so the outcome is NOT yet measured: a lone GND-only diagnostic did not finish inside a 200s bound (each edge builds heavy 0.10mm grids). C1-neutrality is therefore NOT claimed for GND - the authorised run will measure it.

measured_read_from_the_authorised_run_K2.former_crashes_now_named: 244 x no-free-start-node (the retry now actually executes and reports a reason)
measured_read_from_the_authorised_run_K2.added: 68 -> 68 (IDENTICAL to the R1392 baseline) => C1-NEUTRAL at whole-run level
measured_read_from_the_authorised_run_K2.conclusion: the GND/pour + MCU_VDD port-retry class produces no copper either way: the fix is neutral for C1 and it converts an OPAQUE 244-block crash into a NAMED 244-block reachability reason. The honest caveat of the previous window is therefore RESOLVED: neutrality is now measured, not claimed - and it also proves the capability needed next is endpoint START-NODE REACHABILITY, not another allocator.
